doc.title: Buddy Burns and Frank Pasley Interview, 1968-09-23

title: Fred Washington, pianist who could read music
summary: Pasley worked with Fred Washington at a taxi dancehall; they compare his reading ability with Jelly Roll Morton's.

story.theme_name: Pianists: who played, who influenced whom
story.community_name: Remembering Jelly Roll Morton: the man, the band

blocks.x: Fred Washington? Yeah. Yeah, I worked with him. Yeah? Yeah, Taxi Dancehall, he's dead now.
Yeah, he was a great piano player, I think.
Yeah. Somebody said even Martin was afraid of him, because he was better than Martin.
Yeah, but the only thing, Fred couldn't read the music. Jell-O Road couldn't read nothing.
He was a speller, I think, yeah.
Pick, pick, pick. Fred Washington could read their music.
He made some records in 1922 here. Yeah. With Kit Ory and Toody. Yeah. And Mutt.
